name: mcp-playwright
description: MCP server package for Playwright, providing stateful browser automation and in-browser UI verification. The server inlines the accessibility tree on every action, so prefer `playwright-cli` (see the `playwright` skill) for scripted flows and keep this for loops that need the model reasoning over page structure turn by turn. Do not pass `--snapshot-mode none`: element refs come from snapshots, so it removes the ability to interact.
